text:
Maya (PM): quick sync — need final call on MVP cutlist for the Acme pilot. We either push launch 2w or cut embeddings cache + tenant routing to v1. Signal from acct team: Acme will sign if SSO + pilot perf are stable. @Dave any perf risk if we keep embeddings cache out?

Dave (Eng): embeddings cache is medium-high infra work. Without it we see ~2–3x token cost for long sessions. If we cut it, can we apply strict rate limits + a temporary prefix-cache hack to reduce ops?

Elena (Design): UX for tenant routing is mostly nav and consent flows, low dev. Can slide to v1 if necessary, but needs copy. :thumbsup:

Samir (SRE): infra wise, removing cache reduces complexity. But we need autoscale limits for spike safety. I can add a circuit-breaker + alerting for the pilot.

Jules (Data): cutting embeddings will degrade search relevance in long-dialog scenarios. Could we instead keep a lighter-weight embedding model or quantize to reduce cost?

Maya (PM): options: A) delay launch by 2w to include embeddings cache + tenant routing; B) ship on current date with tenant routing (light UX) and postpone embed-cache; C) ship now with canary for Acme and toggle cache after verification. Vote (react or reply) — deadline EOD.

Dave (Eng): leaning C. Canary + feature flags give us rollback safety. ETA for safe cache toggle ~1.5w (engineering + tests).

Elena (Design): C works for design. I'll produce minimal consent copy + two variants for canary.

Samir (SRE): C + circuit-breaker. I will own the rollout runbook and pager hooks.

Maya (PM): rough consensus = C. Plan: keep milestone date, do targeted canary, implement feature flag for embeddings. Owners & deliverables below.

- Owners & due dates:
  - Dave (Eng): feature flag + backend toggle — due in 7d
  - Samir (SRE): runbook, circuit-breaker, monitoring — due in 5d
  - Elena (Design): consent UI + copy variants — due in 3d
  - Jules (Data): evaluation set + pre/post metrics plan — due in 5d

- Acceptance criteria:
```
- Canary traffic <= 5% scoped to Acme tenant
- Service latency P95 < 300ms on canary
- Token cost delta < 1.5x baseline during canary
- Rollback and escalation runbook documented and tested
```

Maya (PM): I'll put a short Confluence doc and create tasks in the tracker. Tagging owners: @Dave @Samir @Elena @Jules

deploy-bot: New task created PROD-4521 — mvp-canary-embcache (assignee: Dave).

Dave (Eng): noted, will break into sub-tasks and post estimated story points tomorrow.

Elena (Design): copy draft ETA EOD tomorrow, will post in #design-review.

Jules (Data): prepping eval set now; plan to run pre/post once canary is live (within 48h).

Maya (PM): thanks team :tada: — closing thread here. I'll DM owners if blockers pop up.
